messages:
Maria L.: Hightide dry-run tomorrow 09:00 UTC — quick status check. Things I care about: customer ACLs, egress NAT, image sync for air-gapped nodes, cert rotation window. Any last-minute blockers?
Jon P.: Net team: ACLs are drafted but Hightide's infra team hasn't applied the inbound rules for the management subnet. I pinged their network lead at 15:12. Waiting on a slice of the firewall ACLs.
Kevin S.: Confirmed I got the ping. I can toggle the egress NAT on our side but if their NAT range isn't whitelisted we’ll drop. @Maria L. can you nudge their infra PM to apply the 10.12.0.0/22 entry?
Sam R.: Airgap image sync: registry bundle is built and signed. We still need their SFTP endpoint to push the bundle (keys rotated last week). Ops asked for an SFTP test user.
Maria L.: I sent the creds to their PM a few hours ago, asked for a connectivity check. If they don't accept by EOD we'll fall back to USB transfer during on-site window — not ideal.
infra-bot: canary-deploy: smoke tests passed against private canary (hightide-canary-01) — /health OK, token store reachable, KV cache warm.
Jon P.: One remaining kernel: we need to confirm our bastion egress fallback if customer blocks 443 egress. Current plan: route telemetry via the regional relay on port 8443. Ops, is that acceptable?
ops-oncall: That's fine but we need a CR and a short rollback note. Also add a circuit breaker for telemetry batching in case relay saturates.
Kevin S.: CR created: CR-2026-118. Telemetry circuit breaker flag: \n```\ntelemetry:\n  relay_enabled: true\n  max_batch_per_min: 5000\n```\nWe'll gate with feature flag `hightide.relay-fallback` during the dry-run.
Sam R.: Image push command for their SFTP (example):\n```\nscp bundle.tar.gz sftp@hightide-ftp.acme.net:/incoming/hightide-bundles/\n```\nIf they can't accept, we unzip locally during on-site.
Maria L.: Code review ping: I left a small comment on the vault-rotator PR about TTL handling, @Kevin S. can you take a look? Need that in before we rotate certs during the dry-run.
Kevin S.: Will review now, should be quick. If we keep TTL >= 5m we avoid race with the deploy agent.
Jon P.: Final dependency check for tomorrow: 1) Hightide applies ACLs, 2) SFTP connectivity confirmed, 3) CR approved, 4) vault-rotator merged. If any of these slip, we revert to the on-site USB fallback and reschedule cert rotation.
Maria L.: Thanks. I'll open a short async status thread at 08:00 UTC tomorrow and post a final go/no-go. If anyone sees a red, drop a "no-go" reply and list the blocker. :thumbsup:
Sam R.: I'll standby and try an SFTP push tonight (22:30 UTC) to prove the path.
infra-bot: reminder: network-prober scheduled at 08:10 UTC for 10.12.*/24 -> will post results in this thread.
Maria L.: Perfect. Appreciate the quick sync — keeping this tight is the whole point of the dry-run.
Kevin S.: Also, small ops note: in case of total egress block we have a minimal offline telemetry mode (batch-only) that can be toggled with `telemetry.replay_mode = true`. Documented in runbook.
Maria L.: Great. If nothing changes I'll post the 08:00 status.
Jon P.: Copy.
Sam R.: Copy.
